title: Штраф за разговор  (A Fine for Talking)

segments.t: In the dining room near the bar, art director Vika Goncharova hands Max a hefty fine for his mistake, and when he tries to ask her out after work, she raises the penalty even higher.
Мы с тобой в кафешку сходим?
То, что я взяла тебя, ничего не значит.
У него сейчас рост восемь сантиметров.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'Lavrov, a fine of three thousand.' The meaning hinges on 'Lavrov' working together with 'thousand' in spoken Russian. Max answers right away.
'Three thousand?' Max anchors the line on 'three', while 'thousand' completes the thought.
'Right, go on and clean up.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'so' and finishing on 'remove'.
Мы с тобой в кафешку сходим?
'Shall you and I go to a little cafe?' Max brings out the contrast between 'we' and 'with' in a few short words. Vika answers right away.
То, что я взяла тебя, ничего не значит.
'The fact that I hired you means nothing.' Notice how Russian expresses 'that' and 'so' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'We have a business relationship.' The meaning hinges on 'at' working together with 'relationship' in spoken Russian.
'Understood?' Vika raises the pitch on 'understood' to turn the phrase into a direct spoken question. Max answers right away.
'Understood. But shall we go after the shift?' Max brings out the contrast between 'understood' and 'but' in a few short words.
'A fine of five thousand.' The meaning hinges on 'fine' working together with 'thousand' in spoken Russian.
'I think it is kicking.' Nastya brings out the contrast between 'it seems' and 'kicks' in a few short words. Max answers right away.
У него сейчас рост восемь сантиметров.
'He is only eight centimeters tall right now.' Max anchors the line on 'at', while 'centimeters' completes the thought.
'How can he be kicking?' Max brings out the contrast between 'how' and 'he' in a few short words. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Мы с тобой в кафешку сходим?
То, что я взяла тебя, ничего не значит.
У него сейчас рост восемь сантиметров.
And that ends our scene by the bar. Listen out for Vika doubling Max's fine when he refuses to drop the subject of a cafe date.
